issues.detail: The Greek 'τουτης' (of this) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation, which refers to 'this love' (the love of God/sacrifice mentioned in the preceding context).

The Greek 'ινα' (so that / in order that) indicates a purpose or result, but the Vietnamese 'là vì' (is because) renders it as a causal explanation. The Greek structure implies: 'No one has a greater love [than this] so that he might lay down his soul for his friends.'
